newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps-Battered levels dive further.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps-Battered levels dive further.

text.p: The Singapore gas oil and fuel oil swaps took another dive late Monday amid a persistant supply glut and the lack of fresh demand, traders and brokers said.
June and July gas oil swaps were quoted at $23.45/$23.65, plunging at least 60 cents from $24.05/24.30 per barrel quoted this morning.
Traders said the weak swaps levels were reflective of a very weak market.
"There are just too much prompt oil and there are very few buyers," said a trader.
Traders said the physical market may break support at $24.00 or even test the $23.00 mark later today.
Prompt physical gas oil has not traded below $24.00 since July last year.
Some traders attributed the current weak swaps levels to the fall in IPE gas oil futures. June futures fell $3.25, to last trade at $161 per tonne.
Brokers said June jet/gas oil regrade was quoted at $-0.40/-0.10, from Friday's indications at -0.50/-0.40 cents.
Demand for jet fuel was also meagre.
"There is very little fresh demand in the region with India taking one cargo in its last tender", said one trader.
Fuel oil swaps were also indicated lower.
June swaps was last quoted at $99.00/$100.50 down from this morning $99.75/$101.00. July was quoted at $98.00/$99.00 lower from $98.50/99.75 earlier.
Traders said the lack of demand and the arrival of arbitrage cargoes have dampened prices.
At least five cargoes sailing eastward are expected to arrive in mid-June, traders said.
